captured_note: Friday post-close snapshot, pulled Sunday. Quotes are stale by design of when they were taken — this proves the fields exist, it is not a live reading.
spot_method: Interpolated from the delta-0.5 crossing between the 7650 call (delta 0.564) and the 7675 call (delta 0.354). Not a quoted index level — SPX spot was not fetched directly.
coverage_note: Calls only, one expiry, eight strikes. A full surface needs puts as well and several expiries — that is one more pull, not a different capability.
greeks_gap_note: Deep in-the-money strikes (7100-7300) returned null greeks and null implied volatility on the same call. Sparse coverage away from the money is real and must be handled, not assumed away.
